{{Quote|Uglier than my twisted Sith grandmother, but he has a vicious streak uncommon in slaves.|[[Harkun]]|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
'''Argog''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Gran/Legends|Gran]] [[Sith acolyte/Legends|Sith Acolyte]] of the [[Sith Academy (Korriban)|Sith Academy]] on [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]].

==Biography==
During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], Argog was discovered by the [[Sith Empire/Legends|Sith Empire]] and was forcibly taken from his home [[Planet/Legends|planet]] to face the Sith trials. He was taken in by [[Overseer (Sith)|Overseer]] [[Harkun]] upon arrival and placed in a group three other acolytes to be presented as potential apprentices to [[Sith Lord/Legends|Lord]] [[Darth Nox|Kallig]]. Insulted by Harkun due to his home planet and native language, Argog was successful in the first bout of the trials, but was killed in the second.
